limitations: Pricing transparency: first-party sources in this pass did not establish included_limits, overages, compute_markup, model_markup, minimum_commitment, cancellation, transparency_classification. No full license/hosted parity audit, assurance-report access or fixed one/two/five-person workload costing was performed. Public pricing is dated; missing rates remain unknown.

sources.title: Codex CLI
sources.finding: The CLI supports local tools, scripted execution, saved chats, subagents, image input, web search and cloud task submission.

sources.title: Codex Cloud
sources.locator: Getting started; Why use Codex Cloud
sources.finding: Published cloud environments provide a separate workspace per task and continue while the originating computer sleeps.

sources.title: Authentication
sources.finding: ChatGPT sign-in and API-key routes have different billing and cloud availability boundaries.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.finding: Plus is $20/month; Business is $20/user/month annually for two or more users or $25 monthly; API keys have separate billing and exclude cloud features.

sources.title: Subagents
sources.finding: Current local Codex clients expose parallel subagent threads, results and follow-up controls; custom agent model configuration is documented.

sources.title: Agent approvals & security
sources.finding: Local Codex clients combine OS sandboxing with an approval policy. Legacy cloud setup-secret rules must not be applied to current cloud environments.

sources.title: Codex IDE extension
sources.finding: The IDE extension works beside code and supports file/selection context; this is distinct from cloud and generic ChatGPT features.

sources.title: codex pinned license
sources.finding: The pinned repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0; this does not license every vendor-hosted service.

sources.title: ChatGPT desktop app
sources.finding: The desktop application offers Codex chats and downloads for macOS, Windows and Linux. This evidence concerns the Codex mode, not unrelated ChatGPT Work features.

sources.title: ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
sources.finding: Linux preview supports Codex on Ubuntu 24.04/26.04, Debian 13, Fedora 43/44 and current Arch, on x64 and ARM64.

sources.title: Codex on mobile
sources.locator: Quickstart; Start, guide, approve and review
sources.finding: Codex in the ChatGPT iOS app can start, steer, approve and review cloud or connected-computer tasks. Local execution needs its connected computer awake. Rollout and workspace policy affect access.

sources.title: Worktrees
sources.locator: What is a worktree; Terminology; Getting started
sources.finding: Codex worktree chats isolate repository working files and can be handed between Local and Worktree. Execution remains on the connected project computer or its remote development environment.

sources.title: Cloud environments
sources.locator: Create and publish; Customize installation; Reuse saved state
sources.finding: Published cloud environments capture prepared files. Install scripts and start skills prepare services. Existing tasks retain own files and tools; repository refresh preserves dependency caches.

sources.title: Scheduled tasks
sources.locator: Desktop tasks; Manage scheduled tasks; Permissions
sources.finding: Desktop Codex tasks run on a schedule locally or in worktrees; the app and computer must remain running. Scheduled shows findings and unread attention. CLI and IDE have no Scheduled management UI.

sources.title: Codex Configuration Reference
sources.locator: analytics.enabled; OTel exporters; provider settings; retry settings
sources.finding: analytics.enabled=false disables built-in Statsig metrics. Explicit OTLP exporters remain independent; setting log, metrics and trace exporters to none disables those exports. Provider retries and stream timeouts are configurable.

sources.title: Agent approvals and security
sources.finding: Opt-in OTel logs include API, stream, approval and tool events, with prompt text redacted unless enabled. Codex documents a devcontainer security-boundary option with explicit credential-exfiltration limits.

sources.title: Codex Pricing
sources.finding: Free is $0 monthly for limited desktop usage subject to rollout. Plus $20 includes CLI, IDE, web and iOS. API-key use excludes cloud integrations. Business is $25/user monthly with at least two users; annual rate differs.

sources.title: Remote connections
sources.locator: Before mobile setup; Connect to an SSH host; Handoff
sources.finding: Codex supports iOS and Android control subject to rollout. SSH project chats execute on the remote filesystem after Codex is installed/authenticated there. Handoff moves a chat and Git state between hosts.

sources.title: Codex Open Source
sources.finding: Codex CLI, SDK and App Server sources are public; IDE extension and Codex Cloud are explicitly not open source.

sources.title: Codex CLI
sources.locator: Inspect edit and run; resume; cloud
sources.finding: Codex CLI is the product-owned interactive coding agent that runs on local repositories, supports resumable chats and can submit cloud work. It is distinct from a model-provider adapter.

sources.title: Custom instructions with AGENTS.md
sources.finding: Codex loads global and repository/path-specific AGENTS.md guidance at startup; nearer overrides take precedence, with a default 32 KiB combined limit.

sources.title: ChatGPT desktop app
sources.locator: Get started with the desktop app > Send your first message; exact sentence: "Choose ChatGPT or Codex."
sources.finding: The current app is named ChatGPT desktop app and offers ChatGPT or Codex in its product selector. This establishes a shared desktop surface while retaining Codex as a choice; it does not announce a product-wide Codex rename or merger date.

sources.title: Use ChatGPT
sources.locator: Compare ChatGPT Work and Codex on desktop > Detailed comparison > Where to start
sources.finding: The comparison distinguishes ChatGPT Work and Codex in the same desktop app and directs users to select Codex in the product selector. Codex retains developer project/diff/review surfaces.

sources.title: Codex pricing
sources.locator: Pricing options, Individual and Business / Enterprise cards
sources.finding: Free is $0/month and Go is $8/month, both with GPT-6 Luna in the desktop app subject to rollout. Plus is $20/month with Codex on the web, CLI, IDE extension and iOS. Pro starts at $100/month. Business is $20/user/month billed annually for two or more users, or $25/user/month billed monthly. API-key use is billed at API pricing and has no cloud-based features. Prices are in USD.

sources.title: Codex roles and workspace permissions
sources.locator: Built-in roles and custom roles sections, fetched 2026-11-10
sources.finding: ChatGPT workspaces have built-in Owner, Admin, Member and Analytics Viewer roles with described rights, plus custom roles that grant Codex permissions such as local Codex use, Codex cloud use and managing shared workspace environments.

sources.title: Codex codex-rs/protocol/src/config_types.rs
sources.finding: The released CLI's sandbox modes are read-only (the default), workspace-write and danger-full-access.

sources.title: Codex codex-rs/protocol/src/protocol.rs
sources.finding: The workspace-write sandbox policy limits writes to the working directory plus configured writable roots, and outbound network access is off unless network_access is set to true.

sources.title: Codex codex-rs/utils/cli/src/shared_options.rs
sources.finding: The released CLI has a --worktree option that runs the session in a new managed Git worktree.
